svg.aria-label: The server journey, drawn: the client's portal at the left; the cloud road in cyan up to a server ready under a cloud of light, past our team's confirmation; the plant road in green down past our team's reply, one box installed by one command, and the licence activated on a signed sheet; both roads meeting at the running line - a controller, the edge device, a wall screen and an operator station alive on one pad; seven numbered milestones
